mapper.select:
SELECT w.workspace_id, w.subject, wd.domain_key, md.name AS pm_name, wd.reason, wd.status, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WORKSPACE_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND wm.status = 0 ) AS member_count, wd.active FROM WORKSPACES w
LEFT JOIN WORKSPACE_DOMAINS wd ON w.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAILS md ON w.member_id = md.member_id
ORDER BY w.workspace_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE WORKSPACE_DOMAINS SET ACTIVE = #{active}, REASON = #{reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STATUS = SYSDATE WHERE WORKSPACE_ID = #{workspace_id}
